data.long_meaning: Sharvil is derived from the Sanskrit words 'shar' and 'vilas', which mean 'king' and 'god' respectively. This name is believed to represent the supreme deity Lord Indra, who is the king of the gods in Hindu mythology. It is a powerful and spiritual name that signifies strength, courage, and intelligence. The name Sharvil carries the meaning “King of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvil usually hope their child will grow to embody king of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
